name: Check TRON USDT Blacklist in Telegram

parameters.jsCode:
function input({body}){const m=body?.message,id=m?.chat?.id,reply=m?.message_id;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(id)||id===0||!Number.isSafeInteger(reply)||reply<=0)throw Error('Invalid Telegram message');const address=typeof m.text==='string'?m.text:'';return{chatId:String(id),replyToMessageId:reply,address,looksValid:/^T[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{33}$/.test(address),request:{address,visible:true},text:'Please enter a complete valid TRON address.'}}

return [{json:input({body:{message:$input.first().json.message}})}];

function validate({body,address}){if(!body||typeof body!=='object'||typeof body.result!=='boolean')throw Error('TRON address validation unavailable');if(!body.result)return{valid:false,request:{},text:'Please enter a complete valid TRON address.'};const alphabet='123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';let n=0n;for(const c of address){const v=alphabet.indexOf(c);if(v<0)throw Error('Invalid address');n=n*58n+BigInt(v)}const hex=n.toString(16).padStart(50,'0');if(hex.length!==50||!hex.startsWith('41'))throw Error('Invalid TRON address bytes');const parameter=hex.slice(2,42).padStart(64,'0'),contract='TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t';return{valid:true,request:{owner_address:contract,contract_address:contract,function_selector:'getBlackListStatus(address)',parameter,visible:true},text:'Please enter a complete valid TRON address.'}}

const original=$('Read the TRON address').first().json;return [{json:{...validate({body:$input.first().json,address:original.address}),chatId:original.chatId,replyToMessageId:original.replyToMessageId}}];

function result({body,address}){if(!body||body.result?.result!==true||!Array.isArray(body.constant_result)||body.constant_result.length!==1||typeof body.constant_result[0]!=='string'||!/^0{63}[01]$/.test(body.constant_result[0]))throw Error('USDT contract result unavailable');const blacklisted=body.constant_result[0].endsWith('1');return{text:blacklisted?`TRON USDT contract reports ${address} is blacklisted.`:`TRON USDT contract reports ${address} is not blacklisted.`}}

const original=$('Read the TRON address').first().json;return [{json:{...result({body:$input.first().json,address:original.address}),chatId:original.chatId,replyToMessageId:original.replyToMessageId}}];

description: This n8n workflow template allows users to check if a Tron wallet address is blacklisted on the USDT contract via a Telegram bot. When a user sends the command {walletAddress} through the Telegram bot, the workflow queries the Tronscan API to determine if the provided wallet address is blacklisted. The result is then sent back to the user via the Telegram bot.
